full_name: MSI GeForce RTX 4060 Ventus 2X Black OC
short_description: MSI’s RTX 4060 Ventus 2X Black OC with 8 GB GDDR6, Ada Lovelace architecture, and DLSS 3 support for 1080p gaming.
key_features: 3072 CUDA cores, 8 GB GDDR6, 128-bit bus, 2490 MHz boost, DLSS 3, Dual TORX Fan 4.0, PCIe 4.0
long_description: The MSI GeForce RTX 4060 Ventus 2X Black OC is a dual-fan mid-range graphics card based on NVIDIA’s Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 3072 CUDA cores and 8 GB of GDDR6 memory on a 128-bit bus. It delivers efficient 1080p gaming with hardware-accelerated ray tracing and DLSS 3, while maintaining moderate power draw (~115 W) and requiring a 550 W PSU. Outputs include 3x DisplayPort 1.4a and 1x HDMI 2.1a supporting up to 7680×4320 resolution. The card uses MSI’s TORX Fan 4.0 cooling system for quiet, effective airflow.

full_name: MSI GeForce RTX 4090 Gaming X Trio 24G
short_description: High-end RTX 4090 graphics card with 24 GB GDDR6X, Ada Lovelace architecture, and premium TRI FROZR 3 cooling.
key_features: 24 GB GDDR6X VRAM, 384-bit bus, DLSS 3, advanced RTX-core ray tracing, TORX Fan 5.0, PCIe 4.0.
long_description: The MSI GeForce RTX 4090 Gaming X Trio 24G is one of the most powerful consumer GPUs available, built on NVIDIA’s Ada Lovelace architecture with 16,384 CUDA cores and 24 GB of ultra-fast GDDR6X memory on a 384-bit bus. With robust TRI FROZR 3 cooling and triple fans, it sustains high speeds (boost ~2595 MHz) while delivering extreme performance for 4K gaming, creative work, and AI-driven tasks. Features like DLSS 3 enhance gaming framerates, while rich display outputs (3× DP 1.4a, 1× HDMI 2.1a) support high-resolution multi-monitor setups. Recommended PSU ~850 W with 16-pin power connector.

full_name: ZOTAC Gaming GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER Twin Edge 12GB GDDR6X Graphics Card
short_description: Compact dual-fan RTX 4070 SUPER GPU with 12 GB GDDR6X, high efficiency Ada Lovelace architecture.
key_features: 7168 CUDA cores, 12 GB GDDR6X, 2475 – 2490 MHz boost, PCIe 4.0, DLSS 3 support, 192-bit memory bus.
long_description: The ZOTAC Gaming GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER Twin Edge is a performance-oriented mid-to-high-end graphics card based on NVIDIA’s Ada Lovelace architecture. It packs 7168 CUDA cores and 12 GB of ultra-fast GDDR6X memory on a 192-bit interface, offering strong performance in modern gaming, creative workloads, and GPU compute tasks. With a compact dual-fan cooler and efficient TDP (~220 W), it suits smaller to mid-tower builds while delivering high framerates at 1440p and respectable 4K performance. Standard outputs include 3× DisplayPort 1.4a and 1× HDMI 2.1a, and advanced features like DLSS 3 and hardware-accelerated ray tracing boost both gaming and application performance.

full_name: Sapphire Nitro+ AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
short_description: Premium 24 GB AMD RDNA 3 GPU with 384-bit GDDR6 and 96 compute units for 4K gaming and creative workloads.
key_features: 24 GB GDDR6, 384-bit bus, 96 compute units, RDNA 3, Infinity Cache, FSR support, DP 2.1 & HDMI 2.1 outputs.
long_description: The Sapphire Radeon RX 7900 XTX is a flagship AMD RDNA 3-based graphics card with 24 GB of high-capacity GDDR6 memory on a 384-bit bus, delivering exceptional 4K gaming and rendering performance. With up to ~2500–2680 MHz boost clocks (model dependent) and advanced features such as hardware-accelerated ray tracing and AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution, the RX 7900 XTX excels across demanding titles and creative workloads. Custom Sapphire variants like Nitro+ and Pulse offer enhanced cooling solutions and tuned performance, while DisplayPort 2.1 and HDMI 2.1 outputs support high-resolution, high-refresh setups.

short_description: Overclocked AMD RX 7800 XT gaming GPU with 16 GB GDDR6 and Phantom Gaming cooling.
key_features: 60 compute units, 3840 stream processors, big 16 GB GDDR6, 256-bit bus, DLSS 3/FSR support, triple-fan cooler.
long_description: The ASRock Radeon RX 7800 XT Phantom Gaming OC 16GB offers an overclocked RDNA 3 GPU with up to ~2565 MHz boost clock and 16 GB of fast 19.5 Gbps GDDR6 memory on a 256-bit bus. Designed for high-refresh 1440p gaming and capable 4K performance, it features a robust triple-fan Phantom Gaming cooler, multiple display outputs (3 × DP 2.1, 1 × HDMI 2.1), and advanced AMD technologies including hardware-accelerated ray tracing and FidelityFX upscaling. With a recommended 800 W PSU and dual 8-pin power, it fits enthusiast gaming builds while maintaining strong thermal characteristics.
